create.name: Christina Lee Pratt
create.bio:
Christina Lee Pratt is a shamanic teacher and practitioner in Portland, Oregon, who founded the Last Mask Center in 1990. She grew up in southern Oregon, and the madrone woods, the South Umpqua River and the Pacific shore she roamed as a child remain, in her telling, her first teacher. She is the author of the two-volume An Encyclopedia of Shamanism (Rosen, 2007) and for years hosted Why Shamanism Now?, a weekly internet radio programme whose archive of more than 500 episodes stays free to hear.

The centre teaches an animist, non-traditional path for people who have no inherited lineage to lean on: forming working relationships with helping spirits, well ancestors and the land, and using ritual and shared practice to loosen patterns of domination carried in families and culture. Its online courses include The Basic Journey, a self-paced introduction to drum journeying, alongside energy-body, shadow and ancestral courses, and the in-person Threshold Process opens a four-year community training called the Cycle of Transformation. Several teachers she trained, Langston Kahn among them, now share the teaching with her. She also offers remote shamanic sessions such as soul retrieval and has appeared on shamanic summits run by The Shift Network and Sounds True.

books.title: An Encyclopedia of Shamanism, Volume One: A-M
books.author: Christina Pratt
books.description: The first volume of her two-volume reference on shamanic practice, terms and traditions across cultures, published by Rosen in 2007.

courses.title: The Basic Journey
courses.description: A self-paced online course in eight modules on journeying to meet and work with helping spirits, from technique and framing questions to reading the symbols that come back. It includes a monthly live coaching class with her and a private discussion group.

courses.title: The Threshold Process
courses.description: A five-day in-person immersion of ritual, ceremony and peer practice, led by her or Langston Kahn, that serves as the entry point to the centre's four-year Cycle of Transformation training. Entry is by application and needs three earlier courses.

free_resources.title: Why Shamanism Now? podcast archive
free_resources.description: The free archive of her long-running weekly internet radio show, with hundreds of episodes on shamanic practice and conversations with guests from many traditions.
